cli_agent.run_explain: The kernel's tools are given through an MCP configuration made for each run, and the credential through a temporary file made for each run (mode 0600) — never an environment variable or an argument. Whether the agent may call a kernel tool is decided by Tool permissions in the agent's settings.
cli_agent.savebar_note: Connection options restart the connector when saved. Per-agent settings apply from the next run.

roster.note: The display name and the avatar are changed from “Open settings”. Nothing is applied until you save.
roster.pick_someone: Select an agent from the list on the left.

create.description_sub: Role, manner and what you want it to do. This defines the agent's character.
create.password_sub: Optional. Asked for before this agent is stopped or deleted.
create.routing_sub: Optional. Send a turn to another engine when it matches.
create.face_hint: Up to 5MB. Optional — it can be set or changed later in the agent's settings.
create.face_not_saved: {{name}} was created, but its icon or VRM could not be saved: {{reason}} Set it in the agent settings.

settings.description_sub: Role, manner and what you want it to do. This defines the agent's character.
settings.password_sub: Optional. Asked for before this agent is stopped or deleted.
settings.password_unchanged: Leave empty to keep the current one
settings.password_hint: With one set, you are asked for it when you stop this agent and when you delete it.
settings.always_loaded_sub: Placed in this agent's instruction directory.
settings.always_loaded_hint: Read-only here. Edit the files themselves to change what the agent is told.
settings.always_loaded_unknown: The kernel did not answer about these files.
settings.left_out: Left out whole because it did not fit the shared budget: {{files}}.
settings.engine_hint: Chosen among the reasoning servers. CLI agents (Claude Code / Codex) appear here too.
settings.routing_sub: Optional. Send a turn to another engine when it matches.
settings.fallback_sub: Used when the last rule's engine refuses or fails
settings.fallback_hint: The kernel keeps a fallback per rule, for when that rule's engine answers with a rate limit or an error. This row edits the last rule's.
settings.memory_count: {{count}} long-term. Their contents are on the Memory screen.
settings.memory_count_unknown: The memory server did not answer.
settings.avatar_sub: The face in the chat header and on the roster
settings.avatar_hint: Up to 5MB. If the VRM carries a thumbnail, it can be used instead.
settings.vrm_sub: The 3D model the avatar window shows
settings.vision_sub: Read images that are shown in chat
settings.colour_sub: This agent's accent colour on screen
settings.colour_hint: Used on the agent's mark, the send button and the edge of approval cards.
settings.accent_invalid: Write a colour as hsl(H S% L%) — hue 0–360, the rest 0–100.
settings.tools_hint: Per server. “Default” follows that server's own policy; open a row to answer per tool.
settings.delete_sub: Its conversations and memories go too. This cannot be undone.
settings.default_protected: The agent that ships with ClotoCore cannot be deleted.
settings.unsaved_note: Nothing is applied until you save.
settings.routing_help: Conditions: contains:keyword, length:>N, tools_likely, default. Rules are tried in order and the first match wins.
settings.engine_harness_hint: This engine runs a CLI harness. Which harness, and this agent's model and working directory, are set on

mate.motion_local: Files chosen here play in this window only and are not saved. To keep one for comparison, register it under Motion comparison above.

lab.title: Motion comparison
lab.hint: Import a motion file made in another tool and play it on this partner. This screen does not generate motions with AI. Production notes are saved with the file.
lab.format_hint: VRMA, self-contained GLB, single-clip Mixamo-style FBX, and Y-up humanoid BVH with VRM or Mixamo bone names. Up to 50 MB and 10 minutes. Finger motion is not added to files without finger tracks, and foot contact is not corrected.
lab.conversion_hint: Export NPZ outputs (Kimodo, ARDY and others) and custom rigs to a Y-up T-pose humanoid BVH or Mixamo-style FBX in the producing tool first. Generation and conversion happen in those tools.
lab.local: Files and notes are stored in this browser or app on this device (up to 64 files / 256 MB). They persist across reloads but are lost if app or browser storage is cleared. The report includes notes and file hashes, not the motion files.
lab.registered: Registered. Select Play from start to preview it.
lab.storage_failed: Could not read or save the local library. Storage may be unavailable or full.
lab.import_failed: Could not register this file. Check its format and available local storage.
lab.play_failed: Could not play this motion. The previous motion is kept.
lab.error_format: Use VRMA, GLB, humanoid BVH or Mixamo-style FBX. Convert other formats first.
lab.error_size: Motion files must be 50 MB or smaller.
lab.error_skeleton: Unsupported bone names or reference hip height. Export a Y-up T-pose rig with VRM or Mixamo bone names.
lab.error_invalid: The motion has invalid data, multiple clips, or a duration outside 0–10 minutes.
